content: औषध {%a.%} (-धी|{%f.%}) [औषधि-अण्] Consisting of herbs. .{@-धम्@} .²1 A herb; herbs taken collectively. .²2 A medicament, medicinal drug, medicine in general. .²3 A vessel for herbs. .²4 A mineral. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of Viṣṇu. .²6 Counter-action, prevention; अतिकुधं निषधमनौषधं जनः <ls>Śi. 17. 7</ls>.

औषधिः, -धी {%f.%} .²1 A herb, plant (in general); <ls>Y. 3. 276</ls> <ab>v. l.</ab>; see ओषधि. .²2 A medicinal herb; अचिन्त्यो हि मणिमन्त्रौषधीनां प्रभावः <ls>Ratn. 2</ls>. .²3 An herb which emits fire; विरमन्ति न ज्वलितुमौषधयः <ls>Ki. 5. 24</ls> (तृणज्योतींषि <ls>Malli.</ls>); <ab>cf.</ab> <ls>Ku. 1. 10</ls>. .²4 An annual or deciduous plant; ˚धीपतिः <ab>N.</ab> of Soma, the lord of plants. .{@-पञ्चप्रकाराः@} (1) Juice of a green herb (रस). (2) Powder of dry medicinal billets चूर्ण. (3) Decoction of medicinal herbs (कषाय). (4) Decoction mixed with medicinal powder (अवलेह). (5) A medicine to be pounded like condiment (कल्क). -पञ्चामृतं गुडूची, गोक्षुर, मुसली, मुण्डी, शतावरी. .{@-प्रतिनिधिः@} A substitute for a herb which cannot be secured.
